files_summary.world.json: Sales domain: gmail (70 threaded messages), slack (5 channels + 80 messages), hubspot (60 contacts + 40 deals, cross-referenced by contact_id).
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: hubspot_find_contact
tool_schemas.description: Searches HubSpot contacts by exact email and/or a substring match against first name, last name, or company, and returns the matching contact records. It refuses requests where neither an email nor a query is provided, since there is nothing to search by. It also refuses searches with an invalid email value when email is supplied.

tool_schemas.name: hubspot_get_contact
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single HubSpot contact by contact id and returns the full contact record. It refuses requests with a missing or empty id, or where the id does not correspond to any contact. It also refuses ids that are not valid contact identifiers for this service.

tool_schemas.name: hubspot_update_contact
tool_schemas.description: Updates one or more properties on an existing HubSpot contact by id and returns the updated contact record. It refuses requests with a missing/empty id, a missing properties object, or an empty properties map because there is nothing to update. It also refuses updates for unknown contact ids and for property names or values that are not valid for the contact record.

properties.description: Map of property name -> new value.

tool_schemas.name: hubspot_create_contact
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new HubSpot contact and returns the created contact record. It refuses requests without an email, with an invalid email, or with an email that already belongs to an existing contact, because contacts must be uniquely identified by email. It may also refuse requests where provided fields (such as firstname, lastname, or company) are not valid values.

tool_schemas.name: gmail_find_email
tool_schemas.description: Finds Gmail messages matching the provided filters (sender substring, subject substring, and/or label) and returns the list of matching message records. It refuses requests that provide no filters at all, since an unfiltered search is not allowed. It also refuses requests with an unknown/invalid label value or non-string filter values.

from_contains.description: Substring to match the message 'from_' address.

label.description: Label id filter, e.g. INBOX or SENT.

tool_schemas.name: gmail_get_message
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single Gmail message by message id and returns the message record. It refuses requests with a missing or empty id, or when the id does not exist. It also refuses ids that are not valid message identifiers for this service.

tool_schemas.name: gmail_send_email
tool_schemas.description: Sends a new email message and returns the created message record as it appears in SENT. It refuses requests missing required fields (to, subject, or body), with an empty recipient list, or with recipient addresses that are not valid emails. It also refuses requests where cc is present but not a list of valid email addresses.

tool_schemas.name: slack_list_channels
tool_schemas.description: Lists channels in the Slack workspace and returns a page of channel records, optionally using limit and cursor for pagination. It refuses requests with a limit outside the allowed range or with a non-integer limit value. It also refuses cursors that are invalid or no longer usable for pagination.

limit.description: Maximum number of channels to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: slack_find_channel
tool_schemas.description: Finds a Slack channel by its name (without the leading #) and returns the matching channel record. It refuses requests with a missing or empty name, or where the name does not correspond to any channel. It also refuses names that are not valid Slack channel names for this workspace.

tool_schemas.name: slack_get_channel_messages
tool_schemas.description: Returns the messages posted in the specified Slack channel and returns the message list for that channel. It refuses requests with a missing or empty channel_id, or where the channel_id does not exist. It also refuses requests for channels the caller cannot access.

tool_schemas.name: slack_send_channel_message
tool_schemas.description: Posts a new message to the specified Slack channel and returns the created message record. Refuses requests with a missing or blank channel_id or text, or with text that is not a string. Refuses requests targeting a channel_id that does not exist or that the caller is not allowed to post to.

metadata.name: RelayDesk Sales Orchestrator
metadata.description: Coordinates and automates sales outreach and CRM updates by finding, sending, and logging communications across email, team chat channels, and customer contact records through a single service API.
